response.message: There is now a concrete task to investigate; let it replace the hypothetical AI conversation. Your previous response repeated the plan to act without obtaining an observation. Here, carry out an attempt, check its arithmetic and number usage, and use the available verifier when ready. Keep your own calculation distinct from returned feedback: proposing an expression does not establish that it passed.
response.rationale: Redirects repeated hypothetical planning toward available action and distinguishes self-checking from observed verification.
